snippet.title: Zombie Highway: Driver's Ed - Available NOW
snippet.description:
Zombie Highway: Driver's Ed is a prequel to the upcoming Zombie Highway 2 that enrolls the player in a post-apocalyptic driving school. 

Download it from the iOS App Store FREE: http://bit.ly/zhde-free

Zombie Highway players will feel at home, but the game is 100% new, with all new gameplay, incredible graphics, and infinitely unique randomly generated roads!
